comment: Pages captured from the live archive by TestCapturePages (ANNAS_MCP_CAPTURE=1, or a comma-separated list of names). Pages are stored gzipped as <name>.html.gz and DOI.org's answers as <name>.json, each with its parsed output in <name>.golden.json. Paths are fetched from whichever mirror answers; csl entries come from doi.org.
